name: pyogenic bacterial infections due to MyD88 deficiency
description: Pyogenic bacterial infection due to MyD88 deficiency is a primary immunodeficiency characterized by increased susceptibility to pyogenic bacterial infections, including invasive pneumococcal, invasive staphylococcal and pseudomonas disease.
